reviews.comment: For such a difficult class on the surface, Xie made 410 into one of the best classes I've taken. Lenient grader, exams are not too theory heavy and rely more on applications of theorems, and his approach to teaching was far more intuitive and flexible than most professors who just regurgitate the book. If you need 410, take him!

Amazing prof. I was so nervous for real analysis but he made the course really doable as long as you go to lectures and do the homework. he cares a lot about his students too and was always really helpful whenever I asked him a question. highly recommend.

Real analysis is already a not-so-easy subject but Dr. Xie is a great lecturer and cares about your learning. HWs are reasonable and exams have a nice translation from his practice exams. He writes everything on the board so it's easy to keep up, and he provides many examples if a concept is not clear. Great teaching style and doable for an A or B!
